title: Strategic Business Case: Siemens Energy & NVIDIA — Industrial AI Ecosystem for Advanced Nuclear (SMRs)
bullets: Solved a capital-intensive deployment challenge in advanced nuclear energy by designing an Industrial AI ecosystem combining Siemens Energy hardware with NVIDIA digital twin and AI simulation platforms, projecting 9–12% reduction in Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) and accelerated regulatory readiness for SMR deployment targeting AI data center demand.

Conducted end-to-end market analysis and competitive landscaping using Porter’s Five Forces and productivity frontier modeling to evaluate the global Industrial Metaverse opportunity, identifying market expansion from $34.4B (2024) to $181B (2030) at ~32% CAGR and positioning the partnership for dual cost-and-value advantage through AI-driven simulation.

Built techno-economic and lifecycle financial models estimating 13% CAPEX reduction, 10% OPEX savings, and 7% production output improvement enabled by digital twins, predictive maintenance, and AI-optimized plant operations across SMR asset lifecycles.

Led user research and customer segmentation for hyperscale data centers and industrial energy buyers, analyzing a validated 14 GW early-stage SMR demand pipeline and identifying regulatory approval timelines and prototyping costs as primary adoption friction points.

Designed a platform-led go-to-market (GTM) strategy positioning Siemens as the standardized infrastructure layer within a multi-sided ecosystem, enabling a data network effect where increased deployments improve AI simulation accuracy and reduce certification timelines.

Developed an Asset Information Management (AIM) lifecycle roadmap spanning as-required → as-designed → as-built → as-operated → as-maintained, ensuring digital continuity and long-term operational intelligence across nuclear infrastructure products.
